description: Application under Section 73 to vary condition 12 (Operational Management Plan – Roof Terrace) of planning consent reference P2022/0871/FUL dated 9th December 2022 for the 'Partial demolition of the existing building, construction of two new floors, reconfiguration of floorspace and renewal of the existing facades to provide new office floorspace (Use Class E), retail floorspace (Use Class E), a replacement public house (Sui Generis), plus new access arrangements, landscaping improvements, new public realm and other associated works.'
